name: Mournful Petals Haunt

source.title: Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun

disable: DC 31 Occultism check or DC 31 Religion check (expert) to weaken the haunt, DC 29 Deception check or DC 29 Diplomacy check (expert) to soothe the haunt's sorrow; three total successes in any combination are required to disable the haunt.
reset: The petals disperse after 1 minute and reset after 1 day.
routine: (1 action) The flower petals surge through the room, dealing 2d10+13 slashing damage to all creatures in the area (DC 32 basic Reflex save save). A creature that fails is additionally Frightened 2 (Frightened 4 on a critical failure).

items.name: Scattered Memories
items.text:
Trigger Two or more creatures enter the area

---
Effect Fragments of Mirida's scattered thoughts and memories manifest in the room as flower petals, the sounds of weeping, whimpers of pain, and shrieks echo through the area, dealing 2d10+13 mental damage to all intelligent creatures in the area (DC 32 basic Will save save). The haunt then rolls initiative.

text: A flurry of scattered flower petals flies through the area, as psychic impressions of pain, sorrow, and being trapped assail the living—Mirida's scattered memories.
